title: First task: create a greeting document

presentation.request: Create one greeting document in this demo project.
user_sees: A new document contains the line Hello OneCrew.
acceptance_steps: Open the document and read the greeting.
Confirm that the content check passed.
presentation.not_doing: No changes to other project files.

understanding.restated_goal: Create docs/hello-onecrew.md with the single line Hello OneCrew, optionally followed by one final newline.
understanding.no_unknowns_because: The task creates one new file with specified text in the docs directory created by init.

preconditions.why: The project needs an initial commit.

output: docs/hello-onecrew.md contains only Hello OneCrew and an optional final newline.

milestones.title: The greeting document has the expected content

argv: $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'; try { $p = Join-Path (Get-Location).Path 'docs/hello-onecrew.md'; $t = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($p); if ($t -ceq 'Hello OneCrew' -or $t -ceq "Hello OneCrew`n" -or $t -ceq "Hello OneCrew`r`n") { Write-Output 'PASS: greeting content matches'; exit 0 }; Write-Output 'FAIL: unexpected greeting content'; exit 1 } catch { Write-Output 'FAIL: greeting file could not be read'; exit 1 }
